breakdowns.sentence: We hadn't eaten anything since the night before.
breakdowns.translation: 我們從前一天晚上之後就什麼都沒吃。

points.label: Past Perfect 否定句
points.text: Subject + had not + past participle + object + since + past time
points.note: 用 had not eaten 表示在機場那個過去時間點之前，從前一晚開始就已經沒有吃東西。

breakdowns.sentence: I had the deluxe meal that has pancakes, bacon, tater tots, and a piece of toast.
breakdowns.translation: 我點了豪華餐，裡面有鬆餅、培根、薯餅球和一片吐司。

points.label: Relative Clause with that
points.note: that has... 補充說明前面的 the deluxe meal 裡面包含什麼。

breakdowns.sentence: We got the biggest ice cream cones I've ever seen.
breakdowns.translation: 我們拿到了我見過最大的冰淇淋甜筒。

points.label: Superlative + Present Perfect
points.text: the + superlative adjective + noun + subject + have/has ever + past participle
points.note: 用 I've ever seen 表示到目前人生經驗中看過的範圍，搭配 biggest 強調最高程度。

breakdowns.sentence: My aunt's house is in the same city where my family and I used to live.
breakdowns.translation: 我阿姨的家在我家人和我以前住過的同一個城市。

points.label: Relative Adverb where
points.note: where 引導子句，說明 the same city 是哪一個地方，也就是以前住過的城市。

breakdowns.sentence: We all used to live in Sioux City.

points.label: used to + Verb
points.note: used to 表示過去常常或曾經如此，但現在不一定還是如此。

breakdowns.sentence: Instead of chopping down the whole tree, they just cut around it so the cable could go through it.
breakdowns.translation: 與其砍掉整棵樹，他們只是沿著電纜線要通過的地方切開，讓電纜可以穿過去。

points.label: Instead of + Gerund
points.note: instead of 後面接動名詞 chopping，表示沒有選擇砍樹，而是做另一件事。

breakdowns.sentence: I remembered the piano that I used to play when I was little, even though I didn't know how to play the piano.
breakdowns.translation: 我想起小時候常彈的鋼琴，即使我那時不會彈鋼琴。

points.label: even though Concession Clause
points.note: even though 引導讓步子句，表示雖然不會彈鋼琴，但仍然有小時候彈鋼琴的回憶。

breakdowns.sentence: One person, thing, place, or story that you feel grateful for having had as a kid?
breakdowns.translation: 一個你覺得小時候擁有過、因此很感恩的人、事、地方或故事？

points.label: Perfect Gerund
points.note: having had 表示在小時候已經擁有過某人、事、地或故事，現在回頭感到感恩。

breakdowns.sentence: I don't even know how it could have gotten torn up on the ceiling.
breakdowns.translation: 我甚至不知道天花板怎麼會被弄破。

points.label: Modal Perfect with could have gotten
points.note: could have gotten 表示對過去發生原因的推測；說話者不知道天花板過去怎麼會變成那樣。

breakdowns.sentence: That way, we could walk all around the city without feeling hot.
breakdowns.translation: 那樣我們就可以在城市裡到處走，而不會覺得熱。

points.label: without + Gerund
points.note: 介系詞 without 後面接動名詞 feeling，表示做某事時不會有某種情況。

breakdowns.sentence: I think they are just good at scamming people, getting you to pay attention to the show so that behind you, they can take your wallets and your phones.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得他們只是很會騙人，讓你注意表演，這樣在你背後，他們就可以拿走你的錢包和手機。

points.label: get + Object + to Verb
points.note: getting you to pay attention 表示讓你把注意力放到表演上。

breakdowns.sentence: It was the first time that I had ever been to Cane's.

points.label: the first time + Past Perfect
points.text: It was the first time that + subject + had ever + past participle
points.note: 因為敘述的是過去的第一次經驗，所以用 had ever been 表示在那之前從來沒有去過。

breakdowns.sentence: I've been obsessed with trying Crumbl cookies since the first time I saw a video of somebody eating one.
breakdowns.translation: 自從我第一次看到有人吃 Crumbl cookie 的影片之後，我就一直很著迷，想試試看。

points.label: Present Perfect with since
points.text: Subject + have/has been + adjective + since + past time clause
points.note: I've been obsessed 表示從第一次看到影片到現在，這個著迷的狀態一直持續。

breakdowns.sentence: I've been dreaming of this moment for so long.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直夢想著這一刻很久了。

points.label: Present Perfect Continuous
points.text: Subject + have/has been + V-ing + for + duration
points.note: have been dreaming 表示從過去到現在一直期待這件事，for so long 表示持續很久。

breakdowns.sentence: Have you ever tried a Crumbl cookie?
breakdowns.translation: 你吃過 Crumbl cookie 嗎？

points.label: Present Perfect Experience Question
points.note: 用 Have you ever tried...? 詢問到目前為止的人生經驗中是否曾經做過某事。

breakdowns.sentence: Eating a salted pretzel in New York was a dream.
breakdowns.translation: 在紐約吃鹹味蝴蝶餅，真的是夢想成真。

points.label: Gerund Phrase as Subject
points.note: Eating a salted pretzel in New York 整個動名詞片語當主詞，表示這件事本身像夢一樣美好。

breakdowns.sentence: We ate our leftover Chipotle while waiting to board our plane.
breakdowns.translation: 我們一邊等著登機，一邊吃剩下的 Chipotle。

points.label: while + Gerund Phrase
points.note: while waiting 表示在等待登機的同時做另一件事，省略了 we were。

breakdowns.sentence: Taking off from New York City in the daylight was so beautiful.
breakdowns.translation: 白天從紐約市起飛真的很美。

points.label: Gerund Phrase as Subject
points.note: Taking off from New York City in the daylight 是整個句子的主詞，描述起飛這件事很美。
